narration: The process begins with the input query map Q_map, providing initial feature tokens for the pipeline.
Queries pass to an offset network to predict displacements added to reference points P_ref for adaptive sampling.
Deformed coordinates sample relevant feature tokens from the bird's-eye-view feature map F_bev.
Simultaneously, an MLP and dynamic resampling module formulate distribution-based attention weights alpha_i.
The sampled features and attention weights are aggregated and linearly transformed into the query update delta Q_map.
